description: Canonical protected trust-root inventory: every repository-controlled component in the trusted authorization execution closure. Governs trust-root change detection in the base-rooted merge gate, ceremony coordinate generation, and boundary tests. Changes to this file are themselves a protected trust-root modification and require TrustRootUpgradeV1 authorization. The inventory that governs a merge is always the one carried by the merge-gate base commit, never the candidate.

non_authoritative_allowlist.reason: Ceremony coordinate producer only: holds no keys, and every artifact it produces is re-verified and re-digested by the base-rooted gate before any merge decision.
Test suite for ceremony tooling; not part of the trusted authorization execution path.
Defense-in-depth regression suite; the authoritative evidence validation lives in the base-rooted gate module, not in this test.
Test suite for the gate; not part of the trusted authorization execution path.
Local developer preflight helper; never invoked by the trusted workflow and carries no merge authority.
